live.why: The entry path is a regular file inside the scored root.
Exactly one registry row inside `## Registry` carries the id.
The row has eleven cells; a pipe inside a cell adds a field, so literal and escaped pipes are both covered.
The row sits inside the `## Registry` section (fleet census E12); a row under any other heading scores nothing.
The row's used-by token set is exactly the admitted entries citing the id.
The row's recheck cell is an ISO date, an NNd cadence or a symbolic cadence.
The anchor cell carries the receipt's sha256 AND the bytes at the receipt path hash to it.
The entry's gate-quote for the id is a contiguous substring of the receipt bytes.
The entry's gate-quote for the id is 1-25 words long.
The O_NOFOLLOW flag and the S_ISLNK component walk.

not-load-bearing.reason: TOCTOU-only defence in depth: the S_ISLNK component walk already rejects every static symlinked tree (control c1-entry-symlink kills it), and no static tree can kill the open-time flag. Inherited unchanged from the round-35 ledger.

retired.why: Dead code under the round-34 frozen spec: the bound was checked against `found`, which `found == quote` pinned to a frozen short quote. Retired in round 35 and kept retired: the round-36 counter keeps the quote a free variable, so the bound is live there and control c1-quote-long kills it.

note: A clause is covered when its control's committed discrimination receipt records observed=TARGET_MISSED and names both the clause id and the control id; a clause naming no control is uncovered. Exactly one clause may carry a not-load-bearing declaration with a reason, and it must be the frozen toctou clause.
